title: Principal Architect
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI\-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.


By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer\-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real\-time insights.


Today, 1,900\+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Role Overview**


Sprinklr’s Unified\-CXM plaIorm runs on large\-scale Java backend and shared platform software used by many product modules. We rely on core capabilities such as automation, processes, workflows, reporting, and analytics, plus common runtime building blocks (events, APIs, data, and opera8ons).


As Principal Architect, you set technical direction for these platform\-level systems: durable architecture, extension models product teams can adopt safely, and standards for how we build and operate at enterprise scale. You work with senior engineers and engineering leaders worldwide. This is a platform and distributed\-systems role not core AI/ML product development.

 **What you will do**

* Own end\-to\-end architecture for shared Java platform capabilities, including


process/workflow, and reporting/analytics\-class systems and the frameworks that support them.

* Design multi\-tenant, configuration\-driven platforms: clear boundaries between


metadata/configuration and runtime execution, with safe rollout and migration for data.

* Define extension and integration patterns (APIs, events, plugins) so multiple product modules can build on the same core without increasing blast radius.
* Drive event\-driven designs on Kafka and align real\-time processing with batch and background processing where the platform requires it.
* Set standards for GraphQL, gRPC, and REST services, including versioning, backward compatibility, and operability.
* Lead architectural evolution and modernization: legacy decomposition, phased migrations, compatibility strategies, and incremental change that improves the platform without disrupting existing enterprise customers.
* Lead performance, reliability, and cost work: latency, throughput, JVM behavior, capacity planning, observability, and incident follow\-through.
* Mentor senior architects and tech leads; run design reviews; raise the bar for code quality, security, testing, and production ownership.
* Drive AI\-assisted engineering practices: Personally use modern AI coding tools such as Cursor/Claude Code/Codex in day\-to\-day development, and guide teams on best practices for AI\-assisted coding with explicit human ownership and review for correctness, security, maintainability, testing, and production readiness.
* Partner with product, platform/SRE, and security on roadmap, risk, and enterprise customer requirements.

 **What Makes You Qualified?**

* BTech/MTech in Computer Science or equivalent with an excellent academic record.
* 12\+ years of professional software development experience.
* 5\+ years in a senior technical leadership role (e.g. Principal Engineer, Lead/Senior Architect, or equivalent) on backend or platform systems.
* Expert\-level Java and proven work on distributed, multi\-tenant systems at enterprise scale.
* Production experience with each of the following:


o Apache Kafka


o MongoDB or an equivalent document database (e.g. Couchbase)


o Redis or an equivalent in\-memory store (e.g. ElastiCache, Valkey)


o Elasticsearch or an equivalent search platform (e.g. OpenSearch, Solr)


o GraphQL


o Kubernetes


o AWS, Azure, or GCP

* gRPC and/or REST (JAX\-RS\-style) microservices in production.
* Observability and production operations: metrics, alerting, on\-call/incident response, and durable post\-incident improvements.
* Experience leading architecture for work spanning multiple engineers or teams.
* Experience with shared platform libraries or services used by more than one team (versioning, compatibility, coordinated rollout).
* Hands\-on expertise with AI coding tools: Daily active use of modern AI coding tools (e.g.Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) in real software development, with the ability to use them effectively for coding, code understanding, refactoring, debugging, testing, and development workflows, and to guide teams on responsible adoption, review of AI generated code, and production\-ready outcomes.
* Demonstrated delivery and evolution of at least one platform framework adopted by multiple teams.
* Strong architectural judgment across scalability, reliability, performance, simplicity, developer productivity, security, and cost.
* Strong written and spoken English for global collaboration.

**We focus on our mission**: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified\-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.

 **We invest in our people**: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well\-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.


To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.


To learn more about all\-things\-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.

**EEO \- Our philosophy**: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.


Sprinklr is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

  

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.

Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. title: SDE1
description:
### **Position Overview**


We are looking for an autonomous, highly capable **Backend Engineer (2–4 Years Experience)** to accelerate the growth of our cloud\-native microservices ecosystem. In this role, you will transition from just writing code to actively taking ownership of end\-to\-end feature delivery, designing domain\-driven APIs, and optimizing system performance. You will work closely with senior architects to break down monolith architectures or build out new distributed modules, ensuring our systems remain scalable, fault\-tolerant, and highly available.### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Module Ownership:** Independently own the lifecycle of backend features—from scoping and architectural layout to implementation, automated testing, and production deployment.
* **Microservices Development:** Architect and implement high\-throughput, loosely coupled microservices utilizing **Java (11/17\+)** and **Spring Boot**.
* **Database Optimization:** Design scalable relational and non\-relational database schemas. Write, analyze, and optimize complex queries, indexes, and transactions to eliminate system bottlenecks.
* **Integration \& Messaging:** Implement asynchronous communications and event\-driven patterns between microservices using message brokers.
* **Code Quality \& Mentorship:** Champion clean code architectures (SOLID principles). Conduct thorough, constructive code reviews and mentor incoming junior engineers/interns on internal frameworks.
* **Resilience \& Testing:** Maintain high test coverage by writing extensive unit, integration, and component tests. Participate in designing failover strategies (retries, circuit breakers).

### **Required Technical Skills**

* **Core Java Mastery:** Strong expertise in Java (Java 11 or 17 preference), including deep familiarity with Functional Programming (Streams/Lambdas), Concurrency/Multi\-threading, and Memory Management.
* **Spring Ecosystem Expertise:** Advanced hands\-on experience with **Spring Boot**, Spring Cloud (Eureka, Config Server, OpenFeign), Spring Security, and Spring Data JPA / Hibernate.
* **Distributed Systems Foundations:** Proven experience developing and maintaining production microservices. Practical understanding of distributed problems (e.g., distributed tracing, handling network timeouts, idempotent APIs).
* **Data Management:** Proficient with relational databases (**PostgreSQL / MySQL**) and a solid understanding of connection pooling and transaction propagation rules.
* **CI/CD \& DevOps Foundations:** Familiarity with containerization (**Docker**) and deploying/debugging services in cloud environments.

### **Preferred / Highly Value\-Add Skills**

* Hands\-on experience with Event\-Driven architectures using **Apache Kafka**, **RabbitMQ**, or AWS SQS.
* Exposure to NoSQL databases (**Redis,** ) for caching and document storage.
* Experience tracking system health via Observability frameworks (**Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, or OpenTelemetry**).

### **Soft Skills \& Behavioral Traits**

* **Autonomy:** Ability to take a loosely defined product requirement, clarify ambiguities, map out tech requirements, and execute it efficiently without constant oversight.
* **Pragmatic Problem Solving:** Knows when to implement a quick, stable hotfix versus when to pause and advocate for code refactoring.
* **Active Collaborative Voice:** Comfortable presenting technical trade\-offs in sprint planning sessions and communicating clearly across teams.

### **Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or an equivalent engineering discipline.
* **Experience:** 2 to 4 years of proven professional software development experience focusing heavily on enterprise Java applications and backend microservices.

title: Solution Architecture - HCL Commerce
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We're looking for a seasoned **Solution Architect** with HCL Commerce expertise to drive the design and evolution of a multi\-tier B2B commerce platform, steering architecture decisions across legacy Commerce systems, Spring Boot services, and modern Next.js storefronts.

**Responsibilities**

* Establish and maintain target and transitional architecture for multi\-tier B2B commerce, covering WCS store, business logic, Commerce tools, Spring Boot APIs, and Next.js / React storefront
* Direct the design of dual\-run / strangler patterns, deciding which journeys stay on WCS and which move to Next.js and services, while ensuring routing, session, catalog, cart, and order consistency, and establishing cut\-over and rollback procedures
* Create and review solution designs, sequence/integration diagrams, and interface contracts (REST/SOAP), flagging reusability, performance, security, and operability issues before build
* Collaborate with product, delivery leads, QA, DevOps, and enterprise/integration teams on requirements, data conversion, integration testing, and cut\-over activities
* Set coding and design standards for Commerce customization, Spring Boot services, and Next.js storefront to keep squads aligned
* Oversee integration with back\-end systems (ERP, payments, search, CMS, punchout / customer purchasing systems), keeping a clear separation between Preview (authoring) and Runtime (customer\-facing) Commerce environments
* Assess designs and pull requests across Commerce, services, and storefront layers, tracking down complex cross\-layer defects to their root cause
* Provide guidance on capacity planning, caching strategies, search, and failure modes for a high\-traffic B2B storefront
* Coach senior engineers and leads, and document architecture decisions with context, options, and consequences to preserve continuity
* Spot key barriers and use structured problem\-solving methods for complex, multi\-system challenges

**Requirements**

* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 12\-20 years in professional software engineering, including at least 5 years as an architect or in an equivalent principal/staff design capacity on large\-scale commerce or comparably complex multi\-tier systems
* At least 8 years working with HCL Commerce and/or IBM WebSphere Commerce (WCS) 8\.x, spanning store customization, commands/tasks, tools, catalog/order/user/organization flows, and back\-end integration
* At least 8 years of experience in Java / J2EE and object\-oriented design on large IT systems, with a strong preference for WebSphere Application Server background
* At least 5 years working with Spring / Spring MVC, with hands\-on experience architecting Spring Boot solutions, including service boundaries, APIs, resilience, and authentication
* At least 5 years working with REST and SOAP web services, with the capability to define contracts for other teams to build against
* Hands\-on production architecture experience with Next.js and React, covering routing, data fetching, BFF/API integration, and storefront performance, with TypeScript knowledge preferred
* At least 5 years using source control systems, with required Git proficiency
* Preferred background in designing B2B commerce architecture, including punchout functionality, organizational/user models, and contract/pricing complexity
* Familiarity with Agile delivery methods using Atlassian tooling (Jira, Bitbucket/Git, Confluence)
* Strong written and verbal communication abilities suited to both technical and non\-technical audiences

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with headless/composable commerce concepts (API\-first storefronts, BFF, packaged capabilities) and MuleSoft or comparable iPaaS platforms
* Exposure to search technologies (Solr or similar), caching solutions (Redis or similar), and CMS\-driven storefronts (Optimizely or similar) working alongside a commerce engine
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (GKE/Kubernetes or similar) for storefront and Spring Boot deployment, plus WAS/IHS knowledge for Commerce
* Working knowledge of security practices, PCI\-adjacent payment flows, and session/identity management spanning legacy and modern storefronts
* Prior involvement in dual\-run setups or large\-scale commerce migration initiatives

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: Data Engineer - II
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.  



  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.


Introduction to the team:  



  

The Global Finance Technology (GFT) team at Expedia Group builds and operates the data systems that power financial


reporting, revenue recognition, compliance, and cost intelligence across all EG brands and lines of business. Our pipelines


process high\-value financial events — bookings, cancellations, refunds, supplier settlements, and inter\-company


transactions — with the accuracy, auditability, and timeliness that finance, regulatory, and executive stakeholders depend


on.  



  

As a Data Engineer II on the GFT Data Engineering team, you will contribute to the data foundations that underpin EG's


financial data platform. You'll build and maintain reliable ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest, transform, and model financial data


— from point\-of\-sale transaction events through to outputs consumed by Finance, Accounting, Tax, and Treasury teams


globally. Working alongside senior engineers, you'll grow your expertise in financial data patterns, data quality, and


observability while delivering pipelines that meet the high accuracy standards financial systems demand  



  

In this role, you will:  



  

Build, maintain, and enhance reliable data pipelines and services that support financial reporting, revenue


recognition, cost allocation, and compliance workflows across EG brands and legal entities.


* Develop and maintain batch and near\-real\-time data processing solutions using PySpark and Apache Airflow —

including financial data modelling and schema management — to support downstream consumers such as General


Ledger systems, Finance dashboards, and regulatory reporting tools.


* Implement data quality checks, reconciliation validations, and monitoring practices — using Splunk and Datadog —

to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and auditability of financial data across EG's data lakehouse (Apache


Iceberg / Hive / S3\).


* Collaborate with senior data engineers, Finance Technology engineers, financial analysts, and data scientists to

translate business and regulatory requirements into well\-implemented data solutions with clearly documented


data contracts.


* Follow and contribute to engineering best practices for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency — including

testing, CI/CD, deployment automation via GitHub Actions and Spinnaker, access controls, PII handling, and


operational runbooks for financial data systems.


* Develop familiarity with AI/ML\-enabled solutions that improve financial data outcomes, including exposure to AI\-

driven anomaly detection or automated reconciliation tooling, and learn to apply AI/ML concepts to financial data


products at Expedia Group under established guidelines  



  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

  

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance Technology, or a related technical field; or


equivalent related professional experience.


* 3\+ years of relevant professional experience in data engineering or a closely related discipline.
* Proficiency in Python (PySpark) for data engineering, along with solid SQL skills and foundational understanding of

data modelling for analytical and operational use cases.


* Hands\-on experience with data processing frameworks and storage technologies — such as Apache Spark, Airflow,

Hive, and S3 — with a willingness to take ownership of the reliability and accuracy of the data pipelines you build.


* Basic awareness of data governance, access controls, and auditability considerations relevant to financial or

transactional data systems, and openness to learning how AI/ML concepts apply to real\-world financial data


products.  



  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

Some exposure to financial, transactional, or compliance\-sensitive data environments — such as revenue data,


billing systems, payment processing, or accounting data pipelines — even in a supporting or contributing role.


* Experience maintaining data systems in production — including basic performance tuning, monitoring, and alerting

— and a track record of taking responsibility for pipeline quality and reliability.


* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively within a team on data engineering patterns, incorporate code review

feedback constructively, and contribute to shared documentation and runbooks.


* Familiarity with data quality practices and an interest in applying metrics and data\-driven insights to improve

pipeline reliability and the trustworthiness of financial data consumed by business stakeholders.


* Exposure to AI/ML concepts or tooling — such as anomaly detection, data validation automation, or intelligent

monitoring — and curiosity about applying these to finance\-domain data engineering challenges at Expedia Group.

title: QE Manager
description:
About This Role
**6 years of experience**  

**Skills: Selenium, Playwright, Java / Python, REST API Testing, BDD / Cucumber, JUnit / Mockito, CI/CD, Postman / RestAssured, Performance Testing, Git, SQL, Agile, Shift\-Left Testing, Defect Management, JIRA**

**About the Role**
  

We are looking for an experienced Quality Engineer with 6\+ years of experience to design, build, and execute automated test solutions across enterprise applications. You will bring strong test automation skills combined with solid domain knowledge — embedding quality as a first\-class concern across Agile delivery teams. This is a hands\-on technical QE role requiring strong coding ability, deep automation framework expertise, and a shift\-left quality mindset.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design, build, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks covering UI, API, integration, and E2E testing layers.
* Develop automation scripts using Selenium WebDriver or Playwright supporting functional, regression, and cross\-browser testing.
* Build and maintain REST API test automation suites using RestAssured, Karate, or Postman covering API contracts and business logic validation.
* Write unit and integration tests using JUnit and Mockito collaborating with developers to improve code testability and test coverage.
* Build and maintain BDD test frameworks using Cucumber and Gherkin working with product owners and BAs to define business\-readable acceptance criteria.
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines implementing quality gates that prevent defective code from reaching production.
* Champion shift\-left testing practices engaging with developers and architects early in the delivery lifecycle.
* Design and execute performance and load tests using JMeter or Gatling validating application scalability under realistic load conditions.
* Manage defect triage and reporting logging, prioritising, and tracking defects in Jira with clear business impact assessment.
* Mentor and coach junior QE team members sharing automation expertise across the team.

**What We're Looking For**


* 6\+ years of quality engineering experience with strong hands\-on technical automation expertise.
* Strong automation skills using Selenium WebDriver or Playwright building scalable, maintainable frameworks from scratch.
* Solid Java or Python skills writing production\-quality test automation code.
* Proven REST API testing expertise using RestAssured, Karate, or Postman.
* Experience with BDD frameworks including Cucumber and Gherkin for business\-readable test scenario automation.
* Strong CI/CD integration experience embedding quality gates into Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions pipelines.
* Good SQL skills for data validation and reconciliation testing.
* Strong shift\-left testing mindset engaging early in the delivery lifecycle to define testability and quality requirements.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills working effectively across developers, product owners, and DevOps teams.

**Nice to Have**


* Performance and load testing experience using JMeter, Gatling, or k6\.
* Contract testing experience using Pact or Spring Cloud Contract.
* Accessibility testing knowledge including WCAG standards and Axe tools.
* AI assisted testing tools including Mabl, Testim, or Applitools.
* ISTQB Foundation or Advanced certification.
* Experience in Financial Services, Banking, or regulated industry environments.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.  



  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.  



  

**Introduction to team**

The Lodging connectivity Organization at Expedia Group is seeking an experienced backend developer and a seasoned technologist with a passion for building robust, scalable, and high\-performance applications that help millions of people plan their travels and create lifelong memories. Join us as we revolutionize the travel industry!  

  



The organization owns a core lever of Expedia Group's growth: expanding global lodging supply and making it a source of competitive advantage. We build and operate the platform that sources, normalizes, and serves third\-party lodging inventory — powering the shopping, booking, servicing, and claims journeys that travelers rely on every day. Through resilient API integrations and AI agentic workflows, we bring diverse partner content onto a single platform and make it competitive, accurate, and bookable at scale.


We are part of the partner connectivity platform that serves as the backbone of Expedia's business, powering an efficient two\-way marketplace that bridges supply and demand. Our platform sources properties and handles more than 3M transactions per minute. Built with modern technologies like Java, Kotlin, Spring, GraphQL, Kafka, DynamoDB, ML, Elasticsearch, and Redis on AWS, our ecosystem supports millions of travelers in finding the best travel products tailored to their needs.  

  



If you're passionate about creating transformative solutions, tackling large\-scale engineering challenges, and shaping the future of lodging supply, we'd love to have you on our team. Join us, and let's redefine the way the world travels together!  

  



**In this role, you will:**

* Design, build, and evolve scalable, reliable services and software components, including system design, low\-level design, API design, and data modeling to support customer\-facing and platform experiences.
* Lead the technical design across domains and delivery of complex, multi\-quarter initiatives across the 3PI supply system that support shopping, booking, servicing, and claims journeys.
* Take end\-to\-end ownership of complex features or services, from technical design through implementation, deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement in production.
* Break down large, ambiguous business problems into clear technical solutions that can be reused across multiple domains and services, driving streamlined execution by the team.
* Write, review, and maintain high\-quality, well\-tested code while driving best practices in code quality, security, observability, resilience, and performance.
* Improve technical quality and operational excellence by reducing incidents, enhancing observability, and optimizing performance, reliability, and cost.
* Safely integrate and operate AI/ML\-enabled solutions that improve traveler and business outcomes, applying AI\-driven systems, tools, and workflows to production\-grade software.
* Mentor and guide other engineers, sharing best practices in software engineering, testing, and architecture, and raising the overall engineering bar for the team.
* Partner with product, analytics, design, and engineering teams to apply data\-driven decision making, define success metrics, and improve system health and user outcomes over time.
* Contribute to architectural direction by participating in design reviews, proposing improvements, leading communities of practice, and helping shape long\-term technical strategy.
Technologies we use: Java, Kotlin, Spring, GraphQL, Docker, Kafka, DynamoDB, Cassandra, Elasticsearch, Redis, Datadog, Splunk, and AWS cloud.  
* 

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
* 10\+ years of professional, post\-college backend software development experience in an object\-oriented language (e.g., Java, Kotlin, or similar).
* Proven experience owning end\-to\-end delivery for services or components — design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support — within a multi\-service or multi\-domain environment.
* Deep understanding of software design principles, algorithms, and data structures, with a strong command of core engineering practices including object\-oriented design, testing, and version control.
* Hands\-on experience designing and consuming APIs, working with data models and storage systems, and applying system design principles to build reliable, maintainable systems.
* Hands\-on expertise with AI/ML frameworks and tools, and experience applying AI/ML concepts to real\-world products.
* Experience building on cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) with sound architectural patterns and scalable, cost\-efficient, production\-quality systems.
Strong communication skills and a highly effective collaborator — able to articulate ideas to teammates, peers, and leaders, support them with data, and incorporate others' feedback to find common ground.

* Support product discovery, roadmap planning and experimentation by providing data\-driven insights and commercial context
* Leverage multiple data sources to identify trends, answer business questions and uncover new opportunities for product improvement

* Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting complex data and translating findings into actionable business recommendations
* Experience working with cross\-functional product teams, including Product Managers, Engineers, Designers and Data Engineers
* Knowledge of product metrics, experimentation, performance measurement and product analytics best practices
* Experience building dashboards and communicating insights through effective data visualisation and storytelling

title: Data Quality Engineer
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We are looking for a **Data Quality Engineer** to build ETL/ELT solutions and DWH/DB systems at scale. You will create Python\- and SQL\-based test automation, validate DWH/Data Lake pipelines, and embed checks into CI/CD workflows across cloud data services.

**Responsibilities**

* Design automated test scripts to validate ETL workflows and data pipeline behavior
* Execute end\-to\-end data validation, reconciliation, and DWH/DB testing across large datasets
* Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders to align test strategies with data quality standards
* Build reusable, scalable test automation frameworks using Python and SQL
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing and delivery
* Validate data transformation logic and completeness across Azure, AWS, and GCP platforms
* Contribute to Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, retrospectives, and story grooming

**Requirements**

* Professional experience of 4\-6 years in data quality engineering, including ETL automation and Data Warehouse/Data Lake testing
* Strong command of SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and test automation routines
* Hands\-on knowledge of Python for scripting, utilities, and framework development
* Practical experience with one or more Test Automation Frameworks
* Working exposure to Cloud Data Services across Azure (ADF, ADB), AWS (Glue, Lambda, Redshift), and GCP (BigQuery)
* Solid understanding of CI/CD tools and practices, including Jenkins, Git, and Azure DevOps
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and iterative delivery

**Nice to have**

* Experience with data observability or data quality tools such as Great Expectations or Deequ
* Basic knowledge of data governance and metadata management concepts
* Cloud certifications in Azure, AWS, or GCP

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)
